criterion: Builds a complete editable differential channel from TX package to RX termination with no floating signal or reference nodes.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Open the Qucs-S schematic and trace both conductors, packages, transmission lines, capacitor model, receiver, ports, and references.","assets":[],"explanation":"The complete channel topology is required before frequency- and time-domain validation."}

criterion: Uses 32 GT/s, 31.25 ps UI, 16 GHz Nyquist frequency, 85-ohm differential impedance, and the specified 125 mm channel.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Inspect global parameters, equations, source settings, and line lengths.","assets":[],"explanation":"The model must use a consistent PCIe Gen 5 operating point."}

criterion: Retains a four-port single-ended representation until mixed-mode conversion is performed.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Inspect port order, conductor mapping, imported blocks, and mixed-mode equations.","assets":[],"explanation":"Early two-port reduction can hide asymmetry and mode conversion."}

criterion: Implements ideal, conventional 0402, optimized 0201, and plane-relief capacitor-pattern variants.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Inspect variant switches, subcircuits, or separate saved analyses and verify identical surrounding channel conditions.","assets":[],"explanation":"The task requires a controlled land-pattern comparison."}

criterion: Models capacitor ESR, ESL, capacitance, both pads, neck-downs, and local plane geometry rather than using only an ideal capacitor.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Review the capacitor wrapper and supporting field-solver or extracted parameters.","assets":[],"explanation":"Pad and mounting parasitics dominate the discontinuity at 16 GHz."}

criterion: Includes transmitter and receiver package, launch, via, and termination parasitics with documented reference planes.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Inspect every package and launch block and the model index.","assets":[],"explanation":"Package and launch effects must be included in the end-to-end channel."}

criterion: Includes skin effect, copper roughness, dielectric loss, and frequency-dependent delay.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Review RLGC, S-parameter, or behavioral loss settings and material assumptions.","assets":[],"explanation":"A lossless transmission line is not representative at PCIe Gen 5 frequencies."}

criterion: Sweeps 10 MHz to 32 GHz with at least 1,601 points and consistent frequency units.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Inspect the saved S-parameter controller and exported dataset.","assets":[],"explanation":"Adequate bandwidth and resolution are required for TDR and step conversion."}

criterion: Uses consistent four-port ordering, 85-ohm mixed-mode references, and documented de-embedding planes for every Touchstone file.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Review the model index and compare port labels with the schematic connections.","assets":[],"explanation":"Incorrect wrapper parsing can invert polarity or corrupt mixed-mode results."}

criterion: Reports Sdd21 at 8 GHz and 16 GHz for every capacitor variant.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Inspect the mixed-mode insertion-loss plot and numerical result table.","assets":[],"explanation":"Insertion loss quantifies the usable high-frequency channel bandwidth."}

criterion: Keeps optimized 0201 Sdd21 loss at or below 12 dB at 16 GHz.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Read the optimized 0201 Sdd21 measurement at 16 GHz.","assets":[],"explanation":"The task requires a defined project insertion-loss target."}

criterion: Keeps optimized 0201 Sdd11 at or below -10 dB from 100 MHz to 16 GHz.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Inspect the differential return-loss sweep and record the worst value.","assets":[],"explanation":"Return loss reveals pad, launch, and termination discontinuities."}

criterion: Keeps optimized 0201 Scd21 at or below -20 dB from 100 MHz to 16 GHz.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Inspect the differential-to-common-mode conversion sweep.","assets":[],"explanation":"Mode conversion measures channel asymmetry not visible in Sdd21 alone."}

criterion: Keeps distributed-channel TDR between 80.75 and 89.25 ohms outside identified local discontinuities.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Review the differential TDR plot and marked channel regions.","assets":[],"explanation":"The controlled-impedance line must remain within the project tolerance."}

criterion: Reduces peak capacitor-region TDR deviation by at least 30% with the optimized 0201 pattern versus 0402.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Compare local TDR extrema for matched channel variants.","assets":[],"explanation":"The optimized footprint must demonstrate measurable discontinuity reduction."}

criterion: Improves the worst capacitor-region return-loss notch by at least 1.5 dB with the optimized 0201 pattern.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Compare local or gated return-loss minima for the 0201 and 0402 variants.","assets":[],"explanation":"Frequency-domain evidence shall confirm the footprint improvement."}

criterion: Generates a differential step response with documented transmitter swing and 12 ps edge rate.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Inspect the source definition and step-response plot.","assets":[],"explanation":"The time-domain test must use the specified edge stimulus."}

criterion: Settles the optimized step response within +/-5% in no more than 5 UI.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Measure settling from the first edge crossing to the final-value tolerance band.","assets":[],"explanation":"Long ringing creates deterministic jitter and ISI."}

criterion: Extracts a correctly normalized 32 GT/s impulse and pulse response.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Review impulse conversion, time step, UI alignment, and cursor normalization.","assets":[],"explanation":"Equalizer design depends on an accurate sampled pulse response."}

criterion: Implements a causal five-tap post-cursor DFE with one-UI-spaced coefficients.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Inspect the behavioral equations and confirm no future-symbol dependency.","assets":[],"explanation":"The requested receiver equalizer must be causal and reproducible."}

criterion: Reports all DFE coefficients and reduces post-cursor ISI energy by at least 50%.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Compare sampled pulse energy before and after DFE and inspect the coefficient table.","assets":[],"explanation":"The equalizer must demonstrate quantified ISI reduction."}

criterion: Synthesizes at least 32,768 UI using PRBS31 or an equivalently stressful documented sequence.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Inspect sequence generation, convolution length, sample rate, and discarded startup interval.","assets":[],"explanation":"The eye result requires a sufficiently long and reproducible stimulus."}

criterion: Achieves at least 100 mV eye height and 0.35 UI eye width for the optimized equalized channel.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Read the final eye metrics and verify the stated jitter, noise, and sampling assumptions.","assets":[],"explanation":"The optimized channel must produce a usable project-level eye opening."}

criterion: Runs capacitor, geometry, dielectric, roughness, and transmitter-edge tolerance cases.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Inspect the tolerance matrix and confirm every required minimum, nominal, and maximum case.","assets":[],"explanation":"Land-pattern conclusions must remain valid across manufacturing and material variation."}

criterion: Submits all Qucs-S files, models, plots, result tables, and summary so every analysis reruns without manual edits.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Open the package on a clean setup, resolve relative paths, rerun analyses, and compare regenerated evidence.","assets":[],"explanation":"Independent review requires a complete portable model package."}
